svg.title: Rank-frequency

svg.desc: Rank-frequency. How quickly does frequency fall as vocabulary rank increases?. Optional trend · slope -1.573 · R² 0.824 · fitted ranks 4–462. The default curve shows the empirical distribution. The optional unweighted log–log trend excludes ranks 1–3 and frequency-one types, without a documented statistical rationale.
